messages:
ian_support: P1 escalation -> CedarEdge onboarding failing when CI pipeline triggers key rotate + provision. Provision API returns 403 intermittently. Renewal in ~4 weeks, customer ramping. Ticket SUP-177777 opened. Looping CS for handoff and comms.

ops-bot: Alert: 11 provisioning failures for tenant cedaredge-ci in last 9h. Pattern: 403 rotate_provision_race. https://redwood.inc/alerts/SUP-177777

claire_cs: Thanks Ian. I'll take comms and AE handoff. Can eng confirm if this is a platform race condition or a tenant config (CI timing)? Need impacted endpoints and ETA for mitigation.

ian_support: Sanitized repro below — CI rotates key then invokes provision immediately; sometimes provision returns 403:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inc/v1/tenants/cedaredge-ci/provision" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***' \
  -d '{"config":"test"}'
# response: {"status":403,"error":"rotate_provision_race","request_id":"req_ce01"}
```
Customer said their pipeline waits <5s between rotate and provision. Manual rotate sometimes works. SE saw similar for another tenant yesterday.

omar_se: We can run a repro with the customer's pipeline timing and prepare a short-lived maintenance key as a fallback. Claire  can you ask them to pause the pipeline and provide a 15-min window tomorrow 10:30am UTC? Also need a secure ephemeral token upload.

rachel_eng: We merged a concurrent-rotate optimization last night that reduces latency but may create a small coherence window where the validator reads stale key state. Rolling a short mitigation: make rotate operations idempotent and propagate key state to read path synchronously for tenants with active rotations. ETA for mitigation rollout ~1.5h. If that doesn't clear it we'll revert the optimization.

ben_ae: I'll join the call; renewal risk: high. Please draft a short, non-technical note we can send to the customer and a one-paragraph updater for Sales. Include any credits or timeline options.

claire_cs: Draft note for CedarEdge:
"Hi CedarEdge team 
We're investigating intermittent onboarding failures when your CI pipeline triggers key rotation and provisioning in quick succession. We're prioritizing this and plan a short troubleshooting window tomorrow at 10:30am UTC. As a temporary option we can provide a one-time maintenance key or ask you to add a 30s delay between rotate and provision. We'll follow up within 24 hours with a remediation plan and timeline. For urgent issues contact ops@redwood.com or reply to SUP-177777."

ian_support: :thumbsup: Add the ticket link and list impacted endpoints: POST /v1/tenants/:tenant/provision, POST /v1/tenants/:tenant/embeds, and note the CI flow that calls rotate->provision. Marking SUP-177777 as P1.

rachel_eng: Mitigation deployed to canary replicas; monitoring now. If error rate drops we'll roll to prod and publish an RCA. If customer prefers immediate rollback instead of mitigation, we can revert the optimization within ~30m.

omar_se: Secure upload link prepared; will send when Claire confirms the window. I'll run the live repro during the session and confirm whether the maintenance key fixes it.

claire_cs: Owners: Ian = support ticket owner, Omar = SE repro & secure upload, Rachel = eng owner (mitigation/RCA), Ben = AE/renewal. I'll update SUP-177777 with the comms draft and calendar invite, and send the customer note once you confirm mitigation success. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-20260502-09. Runbook: onboarding-rotation-race. Escalation level: CS-P1.

claire_cs: Thanks everyone  keep updates in the ticket and ping here for any changes. We'll include a short sales briefing once we have confirmation on mitigation timeline.
